title: SynthData
summary: SynthData is a standalone Python package for generating synthetic tabular data, offering GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer classes plus metadata detection and quality-report evaluation. Its API and class names directly mirror SDV's single-table synthesizer interface, though the code comments show the CTGAN/TVAE wrapping was never wired to the actual sdv or ctgan packages, making it a derivative reimplementation of SDV's design rather than a caller of SDV.
evidence: synthesizer/ctgan.py:10 '# from ctgan import CTGANSynthesizer as CTGANModel # Example if wrapping' left commented, yet class names GaussianCopulaSynthesizer/CTGANSynthesizer/TVAESynthesizer match SDV's API exactly
needs: Unclear whether synthesizer/ctgan.py and tvae.py internally call the real ctgan/sdv packages elsewhere or are fully independent reimplementations; the shown code has the SDV/ctgan imports commented out.
